zoneRisks.risk: Extreme heat stress with exposed sky conditions.

zoneRisks.intervention: Temporary canopies, cool pavement coatings, perimeter trees.
zoneRisks.risk: Prolonged sun exposure on hardscape amplifying heat retention.

zoneRisks.risk: ~62% calm-wind coverage limiting passive cooling and pollutant dispersion.

zoneRisks.risk: Stagnation and weak cross-flow under NE, N, S winds.

zoneRisks.intervention: 6-10m frontage breaks and shaded pedestrian air paths (+10-20pp).
zoneRisks.risk: Wind shadows from continuous frontages under SW, E, NW winds.
